title: HKUST Summer School 2027
institution: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST)
about: HKUST Summer School 2027 in Hong Kong has two application rounds: the Early Round closes 28 February 2027 and the Main Round, with open applications from 24 February, closes 10 March 2027. Students at exchange partner schools need a nomination first.
card_alt: Card for HKUST Summer School 2027 at The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST) in Hong Kong; Main Round deadline 10 Mar 2027. The background is a generic default photo of a city skyline over a river at sunset and does not show Hong Kong.
